llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a straightforward wrapper for the agenttimes.live API and does not request credentials. Before installing, verify the homepage/docs (https://agenttimes.live) and the pricing/terms for the paid endpoints (x402 micropayments on Base). Be cautious when using the POST /subscribe webhook: you must supply a webhook URL and the service will POST article data (titles, summaries, etc.) to it — do not use a webhook that would expose sensitive or private data. Also confirm you trust the service for content provenance and note the service may fall back to external web search when DB results are few. Finally, if you plan to enable paid/category endpoints, confirm payment details and rate limits on the provider site.
